title: Unique 3-Digit Even Numbers
description:
You are given an array digits.

Your task is to:

Form 3-digit even numbers using these digits
Return the count of distinct numbers you can form

Rules:

Each digit can be used only as many times as it appears
The number must be 3 digits (no leading zero)
The last digit must be even (0, 2, 4, 6, 8)
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
